paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of various stimulus types with a total of ten categories. The categories are presented in no order. The "Draft/Other" category, shown in dark red, occupies the largest section at 26.4%. Following this are "Press Release" in yellow at 18.7%, and "External News Article" in dark green at 18.1%. The "Interview" category, colored in dark blue, accounts for 8.8%, while "Organizational Report" in purple represents 7.7%. "Event Posting" is depicted in red with 6.6%, "Organizational Website" in light purple and "Intra-agency news article" in blue each have a share of 4.9%. The "Email" section, in light green, constitutes 2.7%, and "Social Media Post" at 1.1% is shown in orange. Each slice includes percentage labels next to them, and no slice is visually emphasized or separated from the rest. There is no visible legend included.
